lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 3 distinct vertical line segments identified. One primary high-contrast line in the mid-torso, followed by two secondary lower-contrast lines towards the posterior. Spacing is irregular.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Primary mid-torso line terminates approximately 40 percent down the vertical torso mass. Secondary posterior lines appear as abbreviated segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 distinct white spots located on the posterior haunch above the hind leg joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots align in a diagonal trajectory on the lower haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a spiral lyrate curvature; initial outward vector from the frontal bone followed by an inward and upward sweep.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Tip-to-tip distance is approximately 2.5 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10 percent of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a Red-billed Oxpecker (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) perched on the upper dorsal region.
